description: WHEN TO CALL: before invoking an unfamiliar or external MCP tool or server, and right after any MCP tool or API call fails, errors, times out or returns 4xx/5xx — to learn whether it is down for everyone or the problem is local (config, credentials, input). Returns a verdict (healthy | degraded | down | unknown), live success rate, p50/p95 latency, current error signatures, any active breakage, the connection endpoint, and free/paid with how to pay. Accepts a server name, tool name, npm/PyPI package, GitHub repo or URL; the exact Glimind id is not required (the answer says what it resolved to).

toolId.description: Server or tool to check. Short names work ('playwright', 'github', 'whitemagic', 'memory.search'), as do package names ('@modelcontextprotocol/server-github'), repo slugs ('owner/repo'), endpoint URLs, or an exact id ('mcp-registry/…' or '<server>/<tool_name>').

name: check_tool_reliability
